description: This file defines the ConceptMapTypeEditor class, a custom Java property editor for converting between string representations and ConceptMapType objects within the OpenMRS platform. It handles parsing input text to retrieve ConceptMapType instances and converting ConceptMapType objects back to string form.

classes.name: ConceptMapTypeEditor
classes.description: A custom property editor class for converting string IDs or UUIDs into ConceptMapType objects and vice versa.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a string input to a ConceptMapType object by interpreting the string as either an integer ID or a UUID, then sets the value accordingly.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the string representation (ID) of the current ConceptMapType value, or an empty string if null.
